text.body: sadguruṃ saccidānandaṃ kevalaṃ karuṇākaram | jñānayogeśvaraṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 || vāṅmanobuddhibhāvānāmatītaṃ parameśvaram | niṣkalaṃ saguṇaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 2 || nirmalaṃ sadayaṃ śāṃtaṃ praṇatākhilamaṅlam | jñānaikarūpiṇaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 3 || bhaktikalpatarormūlaṃ bījaṃ sādhanasampadaḥ | sarvalokahitaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 4 || āvirbhūto hariḥ sākṣāt pāvane gautamītaṭe | rupeṇa yasya taṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 5 || nivṛttimārgiṇo muktiḥ sopānasulabhā kṛtā | kṛpayā yasya taṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 6 || jñānaṃ bhaktirasaṃ yasya yadbhaktirjñānabhāsvatī | tamadvaitaparaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || dṛṣṭiḥ kṛpāvatī yasya nityaṃ pīyūṣavarṣiṇī natāśrayāṃghriṃ taṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 8 || sudhāvijayinī tāpaśamanī lokapāvanī bhāratī yasya taṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 9 || bhāvārthadīpikā yasya anubhavāmṛtajīvanī taṃ buddhibhāskaraṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 10 || śaradindumanojñāṅgaṃ kamalāyatalocanam | padmāsanasthitaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 11 || prasannaṃ paramodāraṃ varadaṃ susmitānanam | ālandivallabhaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 12 || suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ prabhūm | premalaṃ vatsalaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 13 || buddhinadyāḥ śaratkālaṃ pragrahaṃ cittavājinaḥ pāpatāpaharaṃ vande jñānadevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 14 || he tāta ! bhavataivoktaṃ śiśormātā svayaṃ hitā | cittavṛtteḥ samādhānaṃ buddheḥ sthairyaṃ sadāsstu me || 15 ||
